SM.openTreeSum_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g a : ZMod n)
  (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) : SM.openTreeSum (SM.shift a P) ⋯ (g - a) I = SM.openTreeSum P hP g I
types.SM.treeCoefficient_shift:
SM.treeCoefficient_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g a : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treeCoefficient (SM.shift a P) ⋯ (g - a) hn = SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn
types.SM.mainTreeCoefficient_shift:
SM.mainTreeCoefficient_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (a : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.mainTreeCoefficient (SM.shift a P) ⋯ hn = SM.treeCoefficient P hP a hn
types.SM.treesumData_shift:
SM.treesumData_shift {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g a : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treesumData (SM.shift a P) ⋯ (g - a) hn =
    (SM.openTreeSum P hP g, SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn, SM.treeCoefficient P hP a hn)
types.SM.tree_data_eq_of_chi:
SM.tree_data_eq_of_chi {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : SM.LabelledTuple n} (hP : SM.G1 P) (hQ : SM.G1 Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi P i j k = SM.chi Q i j k) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      π.ordinaryWeight P hP g = π.ordinaryWeight Q hQ g ∧ π.rootWeight P hP g = π.rootWeight Q hQ g) ∧
    (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n), SM.openTreeSum P hP g I = SM.openTreeSum Q hQ g I) ∧
      SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn = SM.treeCoefficient Q hQ g hn
types.SM.labelled_chamber_chi_constant:
SM.labelled_chamber_chi_constant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n) (hQ : Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber P)
  (i j k : ZMod n) : SM.chi (↑P) i j k = SM.chi (↑Q) i j k
types.SM.tree_data_labelled_chamber_constant:
SM.tree_data_labelled_chamber_constant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n) (hQ : Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber P)
  (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      π.ordinaryWeight ↑P ⋯ g = π.ordinaryWeight ↑Q ⋯ g ∧ π.rootWeight ↑P ⋯ g = π.rootWeight ↑Q ⋯ g) ∧
    (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n), SM.openTreeSum ↑P ⋯ g I = SM.openTreeSum ↑Q ⋯ g I) ∧
      SM.treeCoefficient ↑P ⋯ g hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑Q ⋯ g hn
types.SM.tree_data_G1_path_constant:
SM.tree_data_G1_path_constant {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {P Q : { P // SM.G1 P }} (γ : Path P Q)
  (hchi : ∀ (s t : ↑unitInterval) (i j k : ZMod n), SM.chi (↑(γ s)) i j k = SM.chi (↑(γ t)) i j k) (g : ZMod n)
  (hn : 3 ≤ n) (s t : ↑unitInterval) :
  (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) (π : SM.IntervalComposition I),
      π.ordinaryWeight ↑(γ s) ⋯ g = π.ordinaryWeight ↑(γ t) ⋯ g ∧ π.rootWeight ↑(γ s) ⋯ g = π.rootWeight ↑(γ t) ⋯ g) ∧
    (∀ (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n), SM.openTreeSum ↑(γ s) ⋯ g I = SM.openTreeSum ↑(γ t) ⋯ g I) ∧
      SM.treeCoefficient ↑(γ s) ⋯ g hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑(γ t) ⋯ g hn
types.SM.treeCoefficient_quotient_chamber_tran:
SM.treeCoefficient_quotient_chamber_transport {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P Q : SM.GenericTuple n) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
  (hQ : SM.polygonProjection Q ∈ SM.chamber (SM.polygonProjection P)) :
  ∃ a,
    Q ∈ SM.labelledChamber (SM.genericShift a P) ∧
      ∀ (g : ZMod n), SM.treeCoefficient ↑Q ⋯ (g - a) hn = SM.treeCoefficient ↑P ⋯ g hn

SM.OpenPlaneTree.weight_eq_signed_product.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

types.SM.RootedPlaneTree.weight_eq_signed_prod:
SM.RootedPlaneTree.weight_eq_signed_product.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

SM.openPlaneTreeSum_many.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

types.SM.openTreeRec_eq_planeTreeSum:
SM.openTreeRec_eq_planeTreeSum.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

  SM.openTreeRec ordinary I = SM.openPlaneTreeSum ordinary I
types.SM.rootedTreeRec_eq_planeTreeSum:
SM.rootedTreeRec_eq_planeTreeSum.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  (ordinary rootWeight : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  SM.rootedTreeRec ordinary rootWeight I = ∑ T, SM.RootedPlaneTree.weight ordinary rootWeight T
types.SM.rootedTreeRec_eq_signed_planeTreeSum:
SM.rootedTreeRec_eq_signed_planeTreeSum.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  (ordinary rootWeight : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  SM.rootedTreeRec ordinary rootWeight I =
    ∑ T, (-1) ^ T.ordinaryCount * rootWeight I T.fst * SM.RootedPlaneTree.ordinaryProduct ordinary T
types.SM.OpenPlaneTree.map_weight:
SM.OpenPlaneTree.map_weight.{u, v} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
  (ordinary : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n}
  (T : SM.OpenPlaneTree I) :
  f (SM.OpenPlaneTree.weight ordinary T) = SM.OpenPlaneTree.weight (fun J π => f (ordinary J π)) T
types.SM.RootedPlaneTree.map_weight:
SM.RootedPlaneTree.map_weight.{u, v} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
  (f : R →+* S) (ordinary rootWeight : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R)
  {I : SM.BoundaryInterval n} (T : SM.RootedPlaneTree I) :
  f (SM.RootedPlaneTree.weight ordinary rootWeight T) =
    SM.RootedPlaneTree.weight (fun J π => f (ordinary J π)) (fun J π => f (rootWeight J π)) T
types.SM.map_rootedTreeRec:
SM.map_rootedTreeRec.{u, v} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
  (ordinary rootWeight : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  f (SM.rootedTreeRec ordinary rootWeight I) =
    SM.rootedTreeRec (fun J π => f (ordinary J π)) (fun J π => f (rootWeight J π)) I

types.SM.planeTree_formal_identity:
SM.planeTree_formal_identity {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  SM.rootedTreeRec SM.formalOrdinaryWeight SM.formalRootWeight I =
    ∑ T,
      (-1) ^ T.ordinaryCount * SM.formalRootWeight I T.fst *
        SM.RootedPlaneTree.ordinaryProduct SM.formalOrdinaryWeight T
types.SM.planeTree_formal_evaluation:
SM.planeTree_formal_evaluation.{v} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n)
  (values : SM.TreeWeightIndex n → S) :
  (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Int.castRingHom S) values) (SM.rootedTreeRec SM.formalOrdinaryWeight SM.formalRootWeight I) =
    SM.rootedTreeRec (fun J π => values (Bool.false, ⟨J, π⟩)) (fun J π => values (Bool.true, ⟨J, π⟩)) I
types.SM.treeCoefficient_eq_signed_planeTreeSu:
SM.treeCoefficient_eq_signed_planeTreeSum {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n)
  (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn =
    ∑ T,
      (-1) ^ T.ordinaryCount * T.fst.rootWeight P hP g *
        SM.RootedPlaneTree.ordinaryProduct (fun x π => π.ordinaryWeight P hP g) T
types.SM.treesum_trees:
SM.treesum_trees.{v} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] (P : SM.LabelledTuple n) (hP : SM.G1 P) (g : ZMod n) (hn : 3 ≤ n) :
  SM.treeCoefficient P hP g hn =
      ∑ T,
        (-1) ^ T.ordinaryCount * T.fst.rootWeight P hP g *
          SM.RootedPlaneTree.ordinaryProduct (fun x π => π.ordinaryWeight P hP g) T ∧
    SM.rootedTreeRec SM.formalOrdinaryWeight SM.formalRootWeight (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn) =
        ∑ T,
          (-1) ^ T.ordinaryCount * SM.formalRootWeight (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn) T.fst *
            SM.RootedPlaneTree.ordinaryProduct SM.formalOrdinaryWeight T ∧
      ∀ (A : Type v) [inst : CommRing A] (values : SM.TreeWeightIndex n → A),
        (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Int.castRingHom A) values)
            (SM.rootedTreeRec SM.formalOrdinaryWeight SM.formalRootWeight (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn)) =
          SM.rootedTreeRec (fun J π => values (Bool.false, ⟨J, π⟩)) (fun J π => values (Bool.true, ⟨J, π⟩))
            (SM.fullBoundaryInterval hn)
